captions.caption: Poured molten metal enters a sand mold.
Orange-hot metal fills the rectangular cavity.
Metal spreads along the mold's perimeter.
Molten material flows across the sand surface.
The mold fills, spilling excess metal.
Steam rises from the damp sand contact.
Metal nears the top of the mold.
Excess metal overflows onto the base.
Pouring stops; metal begins cooling.
Solidifying metal glows orange in the sand.
Smoke and heat emit from the casting.
The metal surface darkens while cooling.
Molten metal settles in the container.
The cast starts hardening into a solid.
Bright glow fades to a dull red.
Metal surface becomes grey and crusty.
Smoke rises from the cooling metal cast.
The casting lies still in the mold.
Cooling turns the metal surface darker.
The cast metal piece appears mostly grey.
Heat continues to dissipate from the metal.
Sand around the metal appears charred.
The casting solidifies completely in the sand.
Close-up of the cooling rectangular cast.
Metal piece is solid but remains hot.
Smoke clears as the temperature drops.
Casting remains undisturbed in the mold.
A wooden tool approaches the hot metal.
The tool pokes at the solidified surface.
A bamboo stick prys the metal loose.
Metal casting is lifted from the sand.
Sand is cleared from the cast edges.
Stick continues loosening the metal piece.
Sand is scraped off the metal's top.
The rectangular casting is unearthed.
Metal piece is nearly free from sand.
Bamboo stick lifts the heavy casting.
Metal casting is flipped in the sand.
Sand falls from the cast's underside.
Hands reach to pick up the casting.
Casting is lifted from the container.
Hands shake sand from the metal piece.
Person inspects the rough metal casting.
Sand is brushed off the metal frame.
Casting is tapped against sand for cleaning.
More sand is removed from crevices.
Person examines the rectangular structure.
Cast piece is turned over in hands.
Rough edges are visible on the casting.
Person continues cleaning the metal object.
A stone taps off excess material.
Metal casting is struck with a stone.
Sand and slag are broken off.
Person holds the metal frame firmly.
Tapping with stone refines the shape.
Casting is inspected for any flaws.
Person cleans the internal metal edges.
Striking the metal with stone again.
Rough casting starts looking cleaner.
Person prepares for further metal refinement.
